title: Characterization of iPSC
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x82frye

steps.title: Coat vessels with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Coat the T25 flask, chamber slide, and any plates with Matrigel and incubate for 1 hour (01:00:00) prior to passaging.

steps.title: Wash and aspirate
steps.instruction: Wash each well with 1 mL PBS and aspirate the PBS.

steps.title: Add Accutase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add Accutase to the wells and incubate at 37 °C for 3–4 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase to each well of a 6‑well plate

steps.title: Collect cells from wells
steps.instruction: Collect cells from the indicated wells using DMEM/F12 and transfer to labeled conical tubes.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells from 2 wells with 3 mL DMEM/F12 per well and transfer into a 15 mL conical tube labeled A
Collect cells from 4 wells with 3 mL DMEM/F12 per well and transfer into a 15 mL conical tube labeled B

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Spin the cell suspensions at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Spin tube A at 750 rpm for 3 minutes (00:03:00)
Spin tube B at 750 rpm for 3 minutes (00:03:00)

steps.title: Resuspend tube A cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL mTesR1 to tube A and gently resuspend the cell pellet.

steps.title: Prepare karyotype sample
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL mTesR1 to the T25 flask, then add 500 µL of the cell suspension for karyotype analysis.

steps.title: Pellet gDNA sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of cells into a 1.7 mL tube, spin at max speed for 15 seconds, aspirate the supernatant, and store the pellet at –80 °C.

steps.title: Pellet RNA sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 900 µL of cells into a 1.7 mL tube, spin at max speed for 15 seconds, aspirate the supernatant, and store the pellet at –80 °C.

steps.title: Plate cells for ICC
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µL of cells in 750 µL mTesR1, then plate 200 µL of this suspension per well into four wells of a chamber slide.

steps.title: Prepare freezing suspension
steps.instruction: Add mTesR1 and 2× freezing media to tube B and mix to obtain the freezing cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL mTesR1 to tube B
Add 4 mL 2× freezing media (20 % DMSO, FBS) to tube B

steps.title: Aliquot into cryovials and label
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the cell suspension to each cryovial (one well yields ~2 vials) and label each vial with Cell Type, Line Name, Passage #, Date, and Your Name before freezing.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL cell suspension to each cryovial
Label vials with Cell Type, Line Name, Passage #, Date, Your Name
